purpose: Produce the highest-quality public article with the fewest possible computational steps by finding where useful work stops becoming visible articles.
primaryGoal: Increase First-Pass Publication Rate while lowering CPU, memory, repair loops, and latency per verified-visible public article.

masterSubsystem.name: Production Intelligence
masterSubsystem.decisionRule: Optimize the earliest shared workflow bottleneck before patching individual tabs or downstream symptoms.

rows.target: Collect unique same-event inputs, not raw volume.
Merge by canonical event before category assignment.
Only complete or clearly developing dossiers reach Writer.
Every draft proves actor, action, facts, unknowns, attribution, and paragraph plan.
Raise first-pass approvals by preventing known failure classes upstream.
Repair only failed component, resubmit, and measure recovery.
Count newly verified-visible articles separately from carried-forward shelf inventory.

weakestStage.target: Repair only failed component, resubmit, and measure recovery.

cohortIntegrity.rule: Stage efficiency is calculated from current-cycle input and newly created output. Existing public shelf inventory is carriedForwardCount and must not inflate first-pass or final approval rates.

stageEfficiency.rule: Production Intelligence optimizes the whole article lifecycle by finding the earliest stage where useful work stops becoming visible articles, while separating current-cycle conversion from carried-forward public inventory.

stages.label: Viable Events

stages.stopAction: Re-segment source inputs into one canonical event before any dossier work.

stages.label: Dossier Ready

stages.stopAction: Enrich or split the Story Dossier; do not send thin or mixed evidence to the Writer.

stages.stopAction: Build Story Understanding from the locked dossier before Writer Reasoning starts.

stages.stopAction: Rerun Writer Reasoning from the locked dossier and required fact plan.

stages.label: Draft Complete

stages.stopAction: Generate only the article tier supported by the dossier; expand evidence instead of padding prose.

stages.stopAction: Run headline-only repair through the Canonical Headline Service after body verification.

upstreamApprovalThroughput.nextAction: Enrich or split the Story Dossier; do not send thin or mixed evidence to the Writer.
upstreamApprovalThroughput.brainRule: When UAT drops, move the story backward to the earliest failed upstream stage. Do not raise throughput by weakening the Editor or padding weak stories.
upstreamApprovalThroughput.formula: UAT = first-pass-approved articles / viable canonical story candidates

sharedWorkflowDiagnosis.rule: When multiple failures share a signature, patch the earliest common workflow layer instead of generating separate Business/Technology/Politics fixes.

rootCauseWorkOrders.rootCause: Headline failures share a common upstream cause: headline construction is not always anchored to the locked dossier, reasoning plan, and completed body.
rootCauseWorkOrders.action: Require actor/action/consequence fields from the Writer Reasoning plan and reject headline candidates before Editor when body overlap or action clarity fails.
rootCauseWorkOrders.preventionRule: Generate headlines after dossier lock and writer reasoning, not from source headlines or loose cluster fragments.
rootCauseWorkOrders.verification: Headline blocker count and headline rewrite rate decline while first-pass approvals rise.
rootCauseWorkOrders.goalImpact: Raise first-pass publication and reduce wasted work.

rootCauseWorkOrders.rootCause: Multiple failures trace to the story object not being complete, stable, or semantically separated before writing begins.
rootCauseWorkOrders.action: Expand or hold as needs-dossier-evidence until canonical event, verified facts, attribution, category, and known unknowns are ready.
rootCauseWorkOrders.preventionRule: The Writer may consume only locked Story Dossiers and must never draft from raw RSS or thin source fragments.
rootCauseWorkOrders.verification: Dossier stage efficiency improves and story-identity/headline-lead mismatch failures fall.
rootCauseWorkOrders.goalImpact: Raise first-pass publication and reduce wasted work.

rootCauseWorkOrders.rootCause: Image work is not always driven by a structured image dossier tied to the story ID and licensing requirements.
rootCauseWorkOrders.action: Create image dossiers from canonical story facts, rank licensed candidates, and keep post-publication image repair attached to the live article.
rootCauseWorkOrders.preventionRule: A clean article can publish with a temporary CE fallback, but must retain an image work item until a matched licensed or CE-generated visual is attached.
rootCauseWorkOrders.verification: Fallback persistence decreases while image mismatch never removes otherwise publishable articles.
rootCauseWorkOrders.goalImpact: Raise first-pass publication and reduce wasted work.

rootCauseWorkOrders.rootCause: Image acquisition can lag article publication, so image tasks need persistent story-attached work orders instead of optional one-shot visibility.
rootCauseWorkOrders.action: Keep image dossiers and generated-image briefs queued by story ID until a licensed or CE-generated image passes relevance and credit checks.
rootCauseWorkOrders.preventionRule: Do not abandon image work after public publication; upgrade the live article when a better image is verified.
rootCauseWorkOrders.verification: Image queue age and CE fallback count decline without reducing public article count.
rootCauseWorkOrders.goalImpact: Raise first-pass publication and reduce wasted work.

headlineVersionMetrics.rule: Headline success means final normalized headline passed the canonical gate, passed first Editorial review, and reached publication without headline replacement.

semanticReclassification.rule: Collector/RSS categories are hints. The locked Story Dossier assigns the final semantic public tab after canonical event identity is known.

sourcePolicy.generatedImages: use CE-generated story-specific image briefs when licensed search cannot find a relevant, credited image

imageIntelligence.rule: Image Intelligence selects visuals from an Image Dossier tied to the locked Story Dossier and keeps image repair alive after text publication.

publicationEfficiencyDashboard.primaryOptimizationMetric: Upstream Approval Throughput, first-pass publication rate, and CPU milliseconds per newly visible article
publicationEfficiencyDashboard.interpretation: The worker exceeded its production budget; reduce repeated repair/rebuild work before increasing collection.
publicationEfficiencyDashboard.rule: Production Intelligence reads the same authoritative public revision and visible tile count as /api/news-lab. Worker batch counts are diagnostic only and cannot redefine public inventory.

boundedImprovementProposal.cause: Headline failures share a common upstream cause: headline construction is not always anchored to the locked dossier, reasoning plan, and completed body.
boundedImprovementProposal.action: Require actor/action/consequence fields from the Writer Reasoning plan and reject headline candidates before Editor when body overlap or action clarity fails.
boundedImprovementProposal.expectedOutcome: Reduce duplicate subsystem fixes, raise first-pass publication rate, and lower repair loops per visible article by fixing the earliest common production cause.
boundedImprovementProposal.measurement: Headline blocker count and headline rewrite rate decline while first-pass approvals rise.
boundedImprovementProposal.risk: bounded-low-to-medium; changes should affect prevention, routing, or caching before standards are loosened.

rules.preventBy: Build headline only from the completed event dossier using Actor + Action + Consequence, then score body overlap before editorial review.
rules.detection: Reject headline candidates with missing actor/action, copied source structure, word salad, or weak body overlap.

rules.preventBy: Require verified facts, primary actors, timeline, source attribution, and known unknowns before prose generation.
rules.detection: Mark candidate needs-dossier-evidence instead of letting thin source fragments reach the Writer.

rules.preventBy: Treat image mismatch as post-publication repairable when article text is otherwise publishable, while keeping an image-repair attachment on the story object.
rules.detection: Require image-topic overlap but do not remove a clean article from public view for a fixable visual mismatch.

rules.preventBy: Convert this rejection into a repair instruction and resubmit through validation before abandoning the draft.
rules.detection: Detect repetitive-sentence-leak and route to the responsible subsystem with the full story snapshot.

rules.preventBy: Merge same-event candidates before drafting and route added facts into the existing story update path.
rules.detection: Compare canonical event keys, primary entities, location, date, and action before a new article is created.

failurePreventionMemory.writerInstruction: Before drafting, read the Story Dossier, Editorial Memory, Headline Pattern Memory, Learner Lexicon, and these prevention rules; then state the verified event, uncertainty, headline direction, and likely editorial risk internally before prose generation.

learningSignal.upstream: Collector and Dossier Builder should prevent mixed/thin events before Writer work starts.
learningSignal.downstream: Publishing Editor and Validator should repair safe issues, resubmit, and write generalized prevention rules instead of exact-string lessons.
learningSignal.behavioralQuestion: What did the Writer do differently this cycle because of prior failures?
learningSignal.optimizationQuestion: Which computation did not contribute to a verified-visible article, and how can the Framework avoid or compress that work next cycle?
